newsitem.title: USA: Metro One Telecommunications gets contract.
newsitem.headline: Metro One Telecommunications gets contract.

text.p: Metro One Telecommunications Inc has signed a multi-year contract with Spring PCS to provide enhanced directory assistance services.

In conjunction with the scheduled launch of services in new markets by Sprint PCS, Metro One said it expects to open new call centers over the next 18 months in metropolitan areas, such as New York, Boston, Dallas and San Francisco.
The value of the deal was not disclosed.

"This contract marks a significant step in Metro One's plan to provide national and local enhanced directory assistance from its nationwide network of local call centers," Metro One President and Chief Executive Timothy Timmins said in a statement.
Sprint PCS is a joint venture of Sprint Corp, Tele-Communications Inc, Cox Communications Inc and Comcast Corp.

The partnership has licenses to provide personal communication service in 33 areas with a population of 190 million. Sprint PCS plans to launch service in 15 to 20 of its markets by year-end, with the remainder to be launched in the first half of 1997.
